title: LuxCustoms
description: LuxCustoms is a premium, high-performance web platform built using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Designed for an elite automotive tinting and detailing studio in Endeavour Hills, Victoria, the site offers a sleek, dark-themed user experience featuring interactive bento-grid service showcases, dynamic Google reviews carousels, and responsive mobile-first navigation.

title: Traversal
description: TraversalHub is the official website for the Traversal technical club, designed to present the club’s mission, events, and team in a modern and structured way. The project focuses on clean UI design, organized content sections, and responsive layout to showcase technical workshops, community updates, and faculty mentorship within the university tech community.

title: Espresso
description: Espresso is a NextJs based web application designed for the startup to showcase their work, goods and courage of they are grown up from the beginning of the career.

title: SehatSathi
description: A React-based project developed during FOSS Hack 2026 that leverages Gemini and Sarvam APIs to analyze medical reports, extract key insights, and present them in a user-friendly format. It simplifies complex medical data through intelligent summaries and natural language processing.

title: Pizzachio
description: Pizzachio is a responsive frontend website created during my early learning phase. The project focuses on clean structure, visual consistency, and layout design using pure HTML and CSS, helping me strengthen my frontend fundamentals.

title: Spotify Clone
description: This Spotify-inspired web application replicates the core experience of a music player. It includes interactive controls such as play, pause, and track navigation, implemented using JavaScript to demonstrate practical frontend logic and UI behavior.

title: Authentication React Application
description: A React-based application designed to demonstrate real-world authentication flows. The project highlights structured component design, form handling, and communication with a backend service using Express.js.

title: College Event Website
description: A college event website developed using Next.js, focused on creating a clean and structured interface for presenting events. The project includes interactive features and early-stage backend integration, reflecting my ongoing learning and exploration of modern full-stack development concepts.
